title: Brian Clement Farm Tour and Tasting Grand Event
content:
“Awaken Your Senses” to 70 Years of Celebration in Optimum Health with World Leading Pioneers of Longevity. Hippocrates Wellness: Celebrating 70 years of guiding global clients to optimum health and peak achievement through personalized wellness solutions. Perfect Foods is announcing a new in-person farm tour at our indoor farm in Goshen, NY. After 40+ years of growing and supplying premium wheatgrass to the Tri-State area — and two generations leading in organic farming and the wellness space — we are finally opening our doors. We heard your requests. And we’re coming through. Because honestly… it’s time. The world is increasingly confused about wellness — what to put into our bodies, who to trust, what’s real and what’s not. Kids are growing up with little to no connection to how food is grown or where it comes from — leaving us dependent on systems we don’t fully understand or trust. This is our chance to change that. Join us for an interactive, hands-on experience where you’ll learn:
  • How real food is actually grown
  • The importance of living soil, quality seeds, and fresh foods
  • How to use food as medicine in simple, practical ways
What you’ll experience:
  • A guided indoor farm tour
  • Tastings of fresh wheatgrass juice, microgreens & juices
  • Harvest your own large microgreen salad
  • Plant your own pot of microgreens to take home
  • Learn how to incorporate living foods into your daily life
  • Have a skill to bring home and learn how to grow in the future your own food
Come to reconnect with your food, your health, and the basics we’ve drifted away from. This is for adults, kids, families — anyone who wants to feel more grounded in what they’re putting into their body. The public has been asking us to do this for YEARS… and the day has finally come. We don’t know when we’ll do this again — so if you’re thinking about it, don’t miss it.
